descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S01 Hospital: three patients' tasks, one completed, on one screen and in Copy Text, no email

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician in Hospital with three seeded patients and six tasks (one already done); one Nursing Home resident with an open task as a bleed probe

When Open the Hospital list → Task Export; tick 'Follow up blood cultures' as done; expand the completed section if it is collapsed; tap Copy Text. The scripted step then reads the clipboard

Then One screen lists the four open tasks, each under its own patient, then the two completed ones at the bottom, each with its patient; no Email control; the clipboard has the same grouping, pending first and completed at the bottom; nothing from the Nursing Home resident

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From UAT TC-07 Steps 1–4 and Expected bullets 1 and 6, AC 2–4 and 11. cp1: mustContain every name and task and 'Copy Text'; mustNotContain 'Email', 'mailto', 'undefined' and the probe; groupedUnder for the pending tasks; attributedTo for the completed ones; same-patient pending-before-completed pairs (Ben, Cara). …

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from failed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92585 ready for pr

On the Hospital task export, completed tasks show on screen but Copy Text leaves them out; it copies only the open tasks.

Evidence: datasets lane known-gap: the completed block is in PR #106, not on main. TFA-92585 is ready for pr, and per UAT §4 every TC-07 requirement is gated, so this ran anyway. The on-screen open-above-completed order is recorded for Q5.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (clipboard through grantPermissions and clipboard.readText; grouping by locator)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
